text:
Alex K: Taking over evening shift — quick handoff for the active alerts. TL;DR: embeddings-metrics pipeline is seeing a Redis memory spillover leading to elevated tail latency and some 503s. I’ve put mitigations in place but this is still in-flight.

Alex K: Active alerts: 3x P95+ tail latency on embeddings-api, 1x redis-memory-usage-high, queue depth for embeddings-worker > 5k. Customer-visible: a subset of large-batch embedding requests returning 503s or timing out (~0.8% of requests last 15m).

incident-bot: ALERT: embeddings-api P95 latency 1200ms (>SLO). incident:INC-2026-ALPHA created. Pageresponse: oncall@redwood +1.

Alex K: What I did so far: scaled embeddings-worker from 6 -> 12 replicas, enabled the read-only replica pool for embeddings reads, and applied a temporary rate-limit for batch size > 1000 on the public route. Also enabled prefix KV cache for hot prefixes.

Alex K: Runbook refs: https://go/runbooks/redis-memory-spillover (follow mitigation steps 1-4), https://console/redwood/alerts/INC-2026-ALPHA (incident doc).

Maya R: Thanks. Which cluster/region is affected?

Alex K: us-east-1 primary. There’s also upticks in us-west but within normal thresholds.

Maya R: Are the read replicas healthy? Any replication lag?

Alex K: Replicas are caught up. Replication lag shows ~30ms. The issue is memory churn on primary due to a hot key pattern from a few noisy customers. I applied a hotkey eviction policy for that keyspace and started sampling top keys.

Liam S: I’ll cover after 02:00 UTC but note I don’t have DB-root creds — I can trigger autoscale and route changes though. If DB-level changes required, ping Chirag.

Chirag P: I’m on call for infra backup. I have DB access and can do redis-cli maneuvers if needed. If we need to evict or rewrite hot keys, I can do that.

Alex K: Coverage plan: I (Alex) primary until 22:00 local (00:00 UTC). Maya secondary until 02:00 UTC (will be primary at that time). Liam will be on-call after 02:00 but limited creds. Chirag is infra backup on pager for DB-level ops.

Maya R: Noted. Any customer outreach planned? Which customers may see errors?

Alex K: A cluster of enterprise customers sending large batched embeddings (>50k tokens) saw the most failures. I’ve flagged two accounts for CX to pre-emptively reach out if errors persist: acct-2334, acct-9981. CX notified via #customer-success.

ops-bot: Deployment notice: rolled a config patch to embeddings-worker to cap batch size at 2k (can revert). Hash: deploy-2026-04-18-embedcap.

Alex K: Metrics/what to watch (in order):
- embeddings-api P95/P99 latency (console -> embeddings-api -> latency)
- redis memory used / memory fragmentation ratio
- embeddings-worker queue depth and error 5xx rate
- top-key heatmap (runbook step 2)

Alex K: Quick commands:
```
# check redis memory
redis-cli -h redis-primary.us-east-1 info memory | egrep "used_memory:|used_memory_rss:|mem_fragmentation_ratio"

# list top keys (sample)
redis-cli --bigkeys
```

Maya R: If the spillover returns, do we prefer scaling or isolating the noisy customers?

Alex K: Short-term: scale and throttle noisy batch sizes. Medium-term: isolate noisy customers onto a separate pool and instrument per-tenant token-bucket. I’ve opened a Jira: INFRA-8249 to track isolation work.

Liam S: If I see a spike after 02:00 I’ll trigger an extra worker pool and roll the rate-limit. I’ll also keep my phone on.

Chirag P: If we need to forcibly evict keys, plan: 1) snapshot keys to S3, 2) run `redis-cli DEL <hotkey>` during low-traffic window, 3) monitor memory and latency. Only do with Alex or Maya approval.

Alex K: Known gaps: between 01:40–02:10 UTC there’s no oncall with DB-root creds (Chirag is reachable but in a short meeting at 02:00). If we expect DB ops in that window, escalate to infra-lead pager.

Maya R: I can approve evictions if we need to, but prefer to coordinate. I’ll be available remote.

Alex K: Next steps for Maya: watch the P99 and queue depth, keep CX updated if errors >1% sustained for 15m. For Liam: be ready to scale pools and flip route fallback. For Chirag: standby for DB ops.

Maya R: Got it. I’ll take over the thread at 02:00 UTC. Alex — leave any last notes?

Alex K: Last note: saved sampling logs to S3: s3://redwood-incident-logs/INC-2026-ALPHA/samples-20260418.tar.gz. If you need the hotkey list, it's in there under `hotkeys.txt`. Also pinned the temporary rate limit config in the console. :thumbsup:

Liam S: Acknowledge. Will monitor through night.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-ALPHA status: mitigation in progress. Severity: high. Next automated update in 15m.

Alex K: Handoff complete. Maya — you’re primary at 02:00 UTC. Closing my watch; ping here for anything urgent.

Maya R: Thanks — taking over. I’ll post a short update every 30m unless situation improves. :mag:
